stories.summary: The ceremony began with a veterans’ march, followed by the arrival of various dignitaries including Prime Minister Mark Carney and Governor General Louise Arbour.

stories.now: Global News: Prime Minister Mark Carney takes off Wednesday for summits in Asia and Ireland where he'll look to advance trade and security ties. Global News: Four soldiers killed in a fire during a training exercise at CFB Wainwright will be honoured at a community Remembrance Day ceremony Wednesday.
stories.backstory: Remembrance Day marks the 1918 armistice that ended the First World War and honours Canadians who served and died in conflicts since. It is not a statutory holiday in Ontario, so most businesses and schools stay open, while federal workers get the day off. This year's ceremonies follow the Oct. 17 fire at CFB Wainwright in Alberta that killed four soldiers and injured 39; three investigations are under way.
